capabilities: Renders vault notes as an 80-level semantic contour landscape
Embeds notes via OpenAI-compatible APIs or local ONNX models
Detects peaks and names them with an LLM or TF-IDF fallback
Searches notes semantically and pans the map to the active note
Exports the landscape as a standalone interactive HTML file
extras: Desktop only (macOS/Windows/Linux), no mobile; requires Obsidian v1.8.7+. Zero telemetry; all processing local or via user-configured endpoints. Bilingual Simplified Chinese/English UI.
problem: Obsidian's file list and graph view do not show where notes semantically cluster, so large vaults hide their thematic peaks and valleys.
